headline: Low clouds are slowing departures at Newark and Chicago O'Hare.

items.text: The FAA reports departure delays of 45 to 59 minutes at Newark and Chicago O'Hare because of low clouds.
Newark is 92% on time (departed within 30 minutes of schedule) for 250 departures so far today, and O'Hare is 91% for 410.
The other hubs are running normally: all seven reporting so far are at 85% on time or better.
